# Deliberate exceptions to docs/api-guidelines.md, checked by api-audit.py.
# One public path per line; say why after a `#`.

# Plain values: they are their fields.
stipple::geometry::Point        # x, y
stipple::geometry::Size         # width, height
stipple::geometry::PhysicalSize # width, height
stipple::geometry::Rect         # origin, size
stipple::geometry::Vec2         # dx, dy
stipple::geometry::Insets       # top, right, bottom, left
stipple::render::Color          # r, g, b, a
stipple::geometry::Affine::new  # the six matrix coefficients, as in every 2D API
stipple::render::Color::rgb     # red, green, blue, as in every color API
stipple::render::Color::rgba    # red, green, blue, alpha
stipple::render::Color::from_hsv # hue, saturation, value
stipple::geometry::Insets::new  # top, right, bottom, left: CSS's order
stipple::geometry::Rect::from_xywh # x, y, width, height, as in every 2D API
stipple::anim::CubicBezier      # x1, y1, x2, y2: CSS cubic-bezier()'s control points
stipple::anim::CubicBezier::new # CSS cubic-bezier()'s four numbers, in its order
stipple::anim::Easing::cubic_bezier # the same, as an Easing
stipple::anim::lerp             # lerp(a, b, t), the universal order

# Closed enums: the set can't grow.
stipple::layout::Axis           # horizontal or vertical
stipple::platform::ButtonState  # pressed or released
stipple::widgets::SortOrder     # ascending or descending
stipple::game::Corner           # four corners
stipple::game::Stick            # left or right stick
stipple::game::AxisDirection    # a whole axis or one of its two halves
stipple::render::LineCap        # butt, round or square: the set SVG, canvas and PostScript share
stipple::layout::LayoutDirection # left to right or right to left
stipple::core::Handled          # a key was used or it wasn't
